title: Liposomal formulation of Fagonia arabica L. enhances antithrombotic efficacy: phytochemical, pharmacological, and computational investigations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46475-46495
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06347G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sarah A. Badawy, Ahmed R. Hassan, Medhat W. Shafaa, Ahmed Mansour, Marwa S. Abu Bakr, Abd El-Salam I. Mohammed
The study confirmed the antithrombotic efficacy of Fagonia arabica through saponin identification and LC-MS/MS profiling. Biological assays and in silico studies supported its activity, and liposomal encapsulation improved efficacy at lower doses.
